RELATION: shared-receiver | APIS: b.inv, b.forceput | RULE: Mutating b.inv affects the same bidict as mutating b directly.  
RELATION: return-flow | APIS: b.inv, b[key] | RULE: The inverse view b.inv must be used to query a value->key lookup after inserting via b[key].  
RELATION: param-dependency | APIS: b.forceput, b.putall | RULE: Use forceput to bypass duplication checks when putall would raise DuplicationError.  
RELATION: lifecycle | APIS: frozenbidict, b.forceput | RULE: forceput cannot be called on a frozenbidict as it is immutable.  
RELATION: completion-obligation | APIS: b.putall, DuplicationError | RULE: If putall raises DuplicationError, the entire operation is rolled back atomically.  
RELATION: config-return-contract | APIS: bidict, frozenbidict | RULE: Constructing with frozenbidict returns an immutable object, rejecting all mutating ops.
